source: TOWN.BIN devkit blob: the scene tool's symbol dump, 36-byte records (char name[32] then u32 value; file_offset = record start = name; each table ends with a terminator record of 32 NUL bytes + 0xFFFFFFFF); identical on the Japanese disc (one name fewer). Parse corrected 2026-09-28 (it used to read value-then-name and gave every name the previous record's value)

F_.what: event flag numbers (index into the save-game event-flag array); F_act_<npc> are the actor flags, F_<scene>_* scene flags
F_.use: flag constants (include/script_symbols.h) wherever a flag test/set call takes a literal

Ftt_.what: event flags, talk-table variant (same number space)

SSTP_.what: scene step ids: the per-scene state-machine steps the scripts wait on (SSTP_ANGEL_APPEAR ...)

mamonogoya_.what: monster-hut (mamono-goya) flags and status slots; 0x8000-based numbers are a second flag bank

FNO_.what: script call numbers 100-212: entries of the script call table at 0x800D3CC8 (entry = number) that the compiled event-script modules and the bytecode VM call by number; the text after FNO_ is the developer's name of that C function

IMG_.what: portrait image ids per character (IMG_B<name>_<pose>; 0..12 within each character's set)

GOODS_.what: shop goods save flags (GOODS_SAVE_FLG_NN), in the flag number space

S_.what: script call numbers 0-34 (and the developer-console band S_printf/S_sprintf/S_getchar/S_exit 90-93): the system-call entries of the same call table (S_open_shop, S_flgtst, S_rand_sn ...; 6 and 16 are the NULL words S_NULL1/S_NULL2; 0-14 except 6 and 9 hold group-slot addresses rather than code). S_ARG_*/S_AEG_* (21-25) are NOT call numbers: they index the script variable table, like V_
S_.use: function names for entries 9 and 15-34 (ledger/evidence/names_proposed.tsv), per-row evidence

V_.what: script variable slots: indices into the variable table at 0x800D401C (V_buki_gosyu_sno 0, V_cheriru00 1 .. V_pad20 20 = the 21 sn work words, then S_ARG_*/S_AEG_* 21-25, V_pobj 26, V_item_type_data 27, V_sys 28, V_gamew2 29)

sn_.what: scene numbers and scene switches (sn_win_sw0.., sn_open_*)

PSN_.what: person (NPC) demo-motion commands PSN_DM_* (home position, talk, walk a way, jump, display on/off, delete)

ANM_.what: animation ids paired with the PSN_DM commands

NUM_.what: counts (NUM_SN_VAR_WORK = 21, the sn work words V_ 0-20)
